message: Hi Jane, I hope you're doing well. I wanted to ask about the school play auditions - when are they happening? Also, how are the kids' health? I heard there was a flu going around. - Mrs. Smith
Morning Jane, just to update you, Tomas came in today with a cough. I've sent him home and recommended he sees a doctor. Let's keep an eye on this to ensure it doesn't spread. - Nurse Thompson
Jane, the PTA is looking forward to the play! We're all excited to see the kids perform. - John Doe
Reminder: Auditions for the school play are next Monday at 3 PM. Make sure to have your lines memorized!
Don't forget, PTA meeting this Thursday at 5 PM. We'll be discussing the upcoming school events. - Oakwood PTA
Script distribution for the play will begin this Wednesday. Please ensure your child picks up their copy.
The following students have signed up for auditions: Emma, Lucas, Mia, Noah, Olivia, and Tomas. Looking forward to seeing their talent!
